ipeds.title: IPEDS Admissions survey, fall 2023 entering class (ADM2023); fall 2023 enrollment (EF2023A); College Navigator (2024-25 expenses)

stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2023 entering class). UofL's 2024-25 Common Data Set is linked from its website only through a document-viewer page that could not be downloaded as text, and no 2025-26 Common Data Set is posted, so the SAT total, GPA and residency splits are not shown. College Navigator for fall 2024 shows 15,668 applicants, 79% admitted, SAT ERW 530/580/640, Math 510/570/630, ACT 19/23/27. Undergraduate enrollment (16,194) and nonresident-alien undergraduates (233) are fall 2023 IPEDS figures; student-to-faculty ratio 14:1 from College Navigator.

cost.notes: College Navigator (IPEDS) 2024-25: tuition includes required fees; on-campus cost of attendance for out-of-state students is $51,460. UofL's own international cost-of-attendance page was not read, so current-year figures may differ
